Every day, farmers rely on The Arthur Companies for more than just market access and inputs
They count on us for straight answers, honest service, and solutions that work. From local agronomy centers to leading-edge research, The Arthur Companies combines the grit of a century-long legacy with a vision for what agriculture can be.
For Growers
You know your acres. We know the market. Our team shows up and competes to earn your business whether you’re hauling to an Arthur Companies elevator, planning for next year, or growing under contract for specialty end-users.
Products & Services
For Partners
The Arthur Companies is a growing agribusiness platform trusted by processors, suppliers, and our industry-leading peers. Our businesses span grain origination, crop inputs, research, logistics, and specialty ingredients—all supported by a culture of integrity and execution.
Products & Services
The principles that have guided our work for over a century.
Since 1906, we've built relationships that last. What began as a single elevator in Arthur, ND, has grown into a multi-state operation supporting thousands of acres.
PIONEERING
Trailblazing isn't a culture we created; it's something we inherited and strive for in all aspects of our business. We are not satisfied with the status quo and are committed to creating new opportunities and higher levels of service.
SERVICE
Consistency where it counts - our foundation was built on our dedication to serving growers, team members, and our communities. We seek to provide value in every single interaction we have with all of our stakeholders.
INTEGRITY
We do not take trust for granted; our team knows that we must earn trust every single day by doing the right thing and treating others the way we would like to be treated. We earn trust by consistently doing what we say we will do.
EXCELLENCE
If a job is worth doing, it's worth doing it right the first time. This is the best way to gain respect, and it's how we've been able to maintain our loyal customer base for over a century. Our journey to excellence never ends.
